'''Garret''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Defense Force]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He commanded a [[Capture of Basilisk|siege]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Basilisk]], which was under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. After the [[Katarn Commandos]] infiltrated the heavily-armed flying fortress of the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Nistola]] and forced the [[Gender/Legends|man's]] surrender, Garret was able to land his forces and take the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] without firing a single shot.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
